# steam-tasks compatibility fixtures

Unmodified workflow sources from shitamachi/steam-tasks, commit
8265ad9772c5c92d3724a0372f17c31a4a8e498d (verified against origin on 2026-10-25).
No credentials or application source are included.

These test real syntax and reusable-workflow discovery. They are **not** a claim
that the complete application CI/image workflow can execute yet. setup-go@v5,
its version-file/cache behavior, Codecov, docker/*, implicit GITHUB_TOKEN and
BuildKit secrets/named contexts require subsequent execution capabilities.
